messages:
Marta (Content): Dropping the near-final launch blog into the draft folder. Includes benchmark snapshot + webinar CTA. Need quick passes: Legal on the numeric phrasing, Demand Gen on gating and HS fields, Growth on headline variants, Ops on staging + publish times. Can everyone check by EOD? :memo:
Julian (Product): Paste the benchmark sentence so I can confirm baseline and infra. Also which model checkpoints were used?
Marta (Content): Current hero sentence:
"In our tests, Redwood Inference lowered per-token serving cost by up to 44% compared to a stock PyTorch FP16 runtime on 8k-context workloads; see methodology for details."
Hero CTA: "Try the demo + register for the launch webinar".
Ola (Legal): Good that it's hedged with "in our tests". We need a visible methodology link and an appendix listing hardware, batch, quantization, and exact commands. Prefer wording: "up to 44% in our tests" and replace any absolute quality wording with "comparable automated-evaluation metrics (see methodology)".
Priyanka (Demand Gen): I recommend gating the slides and making the recording public after 3 days. HubSpot form snippet I need in the draft (example):

```
formId: "hs_ri_sept2026"
hiddenFields: {"utm_source":"blog","utm_campaign":"ri_launch_sep","product_interest":"inference_platform"}
redirect: "/thanks/launch-slides"
```

Also need the webinar date to schedule promos.
Hank (Growth): Headline A/B pair suggestion: (A) "Lower inference costs, predictable latency" vs (B) "Production LLM serving that scales". Add CTA UTM: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=launch_sep so we can track. I'll set CTR -> registration as the primary metric.
Ruth (Ops): Proposed publish window: Thu 2026-09-30 09:00 PT, partner embargo 08:30 PT. I'll test the HS form in staging Wed 16:00 PT. Need final permalink and OG image.
Marta (Content): Timeline: lock copy Wed EOD; legal signoff Thu AM; demand-gen builds form Thu PM; ops preflight Wed. Suggested permalink: /blog/launching-redwood-inference-2026. Open to edits.
Julian (Product): Confirmed infra and commands in the internal runbook: A10G cluster; test script: pytorch_bench.sh --fp16 --no_xformers --seq_len 8192 --batch 1 --seed 42. Model checkpoints: rwinf-v1 and rwinf-v1-quant. Uploading variant table to the runbook now.
Ola (Legal): I'll sign off once the methodology link is live on the draft page and the appendix lists the exact commands. Also prefer we don't call out BLEU numbers in the hero without the full eval table.
Priyanka (Demand Gen): Modal copy draft: "Get the benchmark slides + ops checklist". I'll wire the HS form and the hidden field mappings.
Hank (Growth): I'll add the headline variants to CMS for the A/B. Also recommend a conservative social teaser: "New benchmarks show meaningful cost improvements for long-context inference" and reserve numeric detail for the blog.
Ruth (Ops): Ops staging checklist:
- CMS draft in staging
- canonical + OG image uploaded
- HS form configured in staging + test submission
- CTA UTMs applied
- embargo scheduled in CMS
- CDN invalidation plan ready
I'll run the staging publish + HS form test Wed 16:00 PT and report back.
Marta (Content): Linking internal runbook here: <internal.link>/benchmarks/ri-launch-sep2026 (attached). Appendix includes hardware, exact commands, seeds, model variants, and evaluation datasets. Updated the hero line per Ola's guidance.
Ola (Legal): Reviewing appendix. Wording tweak accepted as long as the link is live on the draft page.
Ruth (Ops): Staging HS form test: PASS. Redirect to /thanks/launch-slides verified, hidden fields captured. All good for publish flow.
publish-bot: Scheduled publish job queued: 2026-09-30T09:00:00-07:00 (blog/launching-redwood-inference-2026).
Marta (Content): Thanks everyone 680 locking timeline. Please react when your task is complete so I can close the thread. :rocket:
